page.layout: One column of Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries. Each entry opens with a large Hebrew headword set in display type at the left. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: literis, כְּמִתְלַהְלְהֵי [?] Sicut insaniens, Proverb.26. verf.18.

להט Ardere, Flammare: Participium, אֵשׁ לֹהֵט Ignem flammantem, Psal.104.4. Plur. לְהָטִים Flammantes, Incendiarii, qui aliorum animos mendaciis & calumniis inflammant & irritant, Psalm.57.5. Pih. לִהֵט Inflammavit, Accendit, Incendit: Praeterit. וְלִהֵט אֹתָם Et inflammabit eos, Malach.4.1. לְהָטָה Inflammavit, Joel.1.19. Futur. תְּלַהֵט לְהָבָה Accendit flamma, Psal.83.15.
לַהַט m. Flamma, Lamina flammans, Gen.3.24. Plur. בְּלַהֲטֵיהֶם vide in לוט.

להם Hithp. הִתְלַהֵם Blandiri: Vel juxta quosdam, Contundi, Conteri, per metathesin cum הלם conveniens. Partic. כְּמִתְלַהֲמִים Sicut blandientium, Prov.18.8. & 26.2. Vel, Quasi contusorum, eorum scil. qui ostendunt se percussos & fractos, ut alios ad commiseracionem commoveant.
להן Chald. Quamobrem, Itaque, Dan.2.6.9. Nisi, Praeterquam, Dan.6.6.
להק לַהֲקָה f. Congregatio, Caetus: Constr. אֶת לַהֲקַת הַנְּבִיאִים Catum Prophetarum, 1.Sam.19.20. per metathesin pro קְהִלָּה.

לו Utinam, Gen.17.18. Quaesò, Gen.23.13. Fortasis, Gen.50.15. Si, Jud.8.19. Et cum א paragogico, לוּא Utinam, Jesa.1.64. וְלֹא Etiamsi, 2.Sam.18.12. Et composito, לוּלֵא Nisi, Gen.43.10. ubi Masoretha notant, reperiri sic quater: vel לוּלֵי, Gen.31.42. quasi ex לוּ & לֹא.
לוג m. Sextarius, Levit.14.12. Mensura liquidorum minima, vigesima quarta pars Sea sive Sati, sex ova continens, scribit Kimchi in lib.Rad.

page.notes: Hebrew words in the first line (literis) and in several entries are uncertain at this scan resolution and are marked [?]. The Hebrew vowel points and a few Latin letters (Caetus, Sea) are hard to read, and the spelling of Hebrew pointed forms may not be exact. The large display headwords are read as printed, but their vowel pointing is uncertain. Entry for לוג: "Sea" may be "Sea" printed with a ligature.
